jobs.title: Senior AI Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer

Company: Sentra
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $190,000–$300,000 per year
Location: San Francisco, CA (Remote-friendly)

About Sentra

Sentra is looking for a high-agency, generalist Senior Backend Engineer to build customer-facing products and AI-powered systems. This role offers meaningful founding-level equity and the opportunity to shape product direction, technical architecture, and engineering standards alongside the founding team.

Remote engineers are expected to travel periodically to the San Francisco or Toronto office for in-person collaboration.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced backend engineer with 5+ years of experience building and shipping customer-facing products. The ideal candidate has experience at a top-tier early-stage startup (Series B or earlier) or as a founder, with a strong product mindset and the ability to connect technical decisions to business impact.

You'll thrive in an early-stage environment where ownership, independent judgment, fast iteration, and end-to-end execution are essential.

Responsibilities

- Own and ship product features end-to-end, from problem scoping and backend implementation to production deployment.
- Design and build LLM agents that reason over large, complex organizational data and deliver reliable results.
- Make key technical decisions across architecture, data modeling, API design, tooling, and engineering quality.
- Lead ambiguous, high-impact projects with minimal oversight.
- Shape product direction alongside the founding team and translate customer needs into technical solutions.
- Work closely with the founding team on customer engagements supporting organizations ranging from hundreds to thousands of employees.
- Take ownership of the product, codebase, and technical decisions in a fast-moving startup environment.

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of backend engineering experience focused on customer-facing products.
- Experience at a top-tier startup (Series B or earlier) or as a founder.
- Proven track record of building and shipping production-grade, customer-facing backend products at scale.
- Deep expertise in Python for production backend systems.
- Strong backend architecture and systems design skills.
- Proficiency in API design and SQL-based data stores.
- Hands-on experience building with large language models (LLMs) or agentic AI systems.
- Ability to set technical direction and deliver high-impact projects independently.
- A generalist engineering mindset, with the ability to contribute across the product rather than focusing exclusively on infrastructure.
- Strong product judgment and the ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience working with customers.
- Proficiency with AI coding tools and the ability to use AI to accelerate development while maintaining strong independent technical judgment.

Ideal Background

Candidates with experience at high-performing startups or product-focused technology companies are particularly encouraged to apply.

Relevant backgrounds may include:

- AI and Machine Learning: OpenAI, Anthropic, Scale AI, Cohere, Anyscale, Weights & Biases, Hugging Face, Adept AI, LangChain.
- Cloud Infrastructure and Developer Tools: Cloudflare, Vercel, Fly.io, Modal Labs, Temporal Technologies, Datadog, Replit, Cursor, Retool, Convex, Resend.
- Data and Analytics: Databricks, Snowflake, PlanetScale, Supabase, Neon, Airbyte, Dagster Labs, Prefect, PostHog.
- Fintech: Stripe, Ramp, Brex, Merge.
- SaaS and Productivity: Notion, Linear, Rippling, Vanta, Deel.
- Consumer Technology: Meta, Uber, Airbnb, Dropbox.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

We're looking for engineers who take initiative, think critically about the problems they're solving, and operate effectively in ambiguous environments.

This role is best suited to product-minded engineers who have demonstrated independent ownership, shipped meaningful customer-facing software, and can make sound technical decisions without extensive guidance.

Candidates whose experience is exclusively in infrastructure, DevOps, data pipelines, or ML models without customer-facing product development may not be a fit.

Compensation and Benefits

- Annual salary: $190,000–$300,000.
- Meaningful founding-level equity.
- Opportunity to work closely with the founding team and influence product and engineering direction.
- High ownership and autonomy in a fast-moving startup environment.

Work Authorization

Candidates should have existing work authorization in the United States or Canada. Visa sponsorship is not generally preferred, although exceptional candidates may be considered.

Work Arrangement

Remote-friendly, with offices in San Francisco, California, and Toronto, Canada. Remote employees should expect periodic travel to an office for collaborative work.

Apply Now

If you're a strong backend engineer who enjoys building customer-facing products, working with LLMs and AI agents, and taking ownership in an early-stage startup, we'd love to hear from you.

Position -
Sr. AI Engineer (Data Scientist)

Location - New Jersey - United States
Duration - Full-time

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior AI Engineer (Data Scientist)
to design, develop, and deploy advanced AI and machine learning solutions that address complex business challenges. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, and AI engineering, with hands-on experience building scalable, production-ready AI solutions.
The candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data engineers, software engineers, business stakeholders, and product teams, to transform business requirements and large datasets into actionable insights and intelligent applications.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, train, and deploy machine learning and AI models to solve complex business problems.
Apply statistical analysis, predictive modeling, classification, regression, clustering, and other advanced analytical techniques.
Develop end-to-end data science solutions, from data collection and preprocessing to model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
Build and optimize AI-powered applications using Python and relevant machine learning and deep learning frameworks.
Work with structured and unstructured data to identify patterns, trends, and business insights.
Develop and implement solutions using Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), where applicable.
Design and implement prompt engineering, model evaluation, and optimization techniques for AI applications.
Collaborate with data engineering teams to build reliable data pipelines and prepare high-quality datasets for model training and inference.
Implement MLOps practices for model versioning, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle management.
Evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics and continuously improve accuracy, scalability, reliability, and efficiency.
Ensure AI solutions follow security, privacy, responsible AI, and governance standards.
Communicate technical findings, model performance, and business recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Stay current with emerging AI technologies, research, frameworks, and industry best practices.

Required Skills and Qualifications

8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, AI engineering, or a closely related field.
Strong programming skills in Python
, including libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, and Scikit-learn.
Strong foundation in statistics, probability, linear algebra, optimization, and machine learning algorithms.
Hands-on experience developing and deploying machine learning models in production environments.
Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets, data preparation, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis.
Experience with model evaluation, hyperparameter tuning, experimentation, and performance optimization.
Knowledge of cloud-based AI/ML platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
Experience with model deployment, REST APIs, Docker, Kubernetes, or similar production technologies.
Familiarity with version control, CI/CD, model monitoring, and MLOps workflows.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures, vector databases, and embedding models.
Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent AI orchestration tools.
Experience with LLM evaluation, fine-tuning, model serving, and inference optimization.
Knowledge of distributed computing and big data technologies such as Apache Spark.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Python visualization libraries.
Experience delivering AI solutions in enterprise environments.
Familiarity with responsible AI, model explainability, bias detection, and data governance.

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical professional who combines strong data science fundamentals with practical AI engineering experience. The candidate should be capable of independently solving complex problems, building scalable AI/ML solutions, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, and translating business requirements into measurable outcomes.

Senior AI Architect

Location - New Jersey - United States
Duration - Full-time

About the role

Quantum Integrators is hiring a Senior AI Architect to design and deliver production AI systems for our enterprise clients. You will own the technical vision for generative AI, agentic and machine learning solutions, from first discovery workshop through to scaled deployment.
This is a hands-on, client-facing role. You will shape architecture, guide engineering teams, and help clients turn AI pilots into secure, governed systems that deliver measurable business value.

What you'll do

Lead the end-to-end architecture of AI solutions: LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and classical ML models.
Partner with client executives and stakeholders to identify high-value use cases, assess feasibility, and define roadmaps.
Select and integrate models, frameworks and platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, open-source models) based on cost, performance and risk.
Design scalable data and integration patterns that connect AI services to enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM and data platforms.
Define MLOps and LLMOps practices covering evaluation, monitoring, versioning, CI/CD and cost control.
Build in security, privacy and responsible AI controls, including guardrails, access management and compliance with regulations such as the EU AI Act.
Guide and mentor engineers and data scientists; review designs and code, and set reference architectures and standards.
Build proofs of concept quickly, then harden them for production.
Support pre-sales: scope solutions, write technical proposals and present to client leadership.
Track emerging AI research and tools, and turn what matters into reusable accelerators for the practice.

What you bring

10+ years in software engineering, data engineering or solution architecture, with 3+ years architecting AI/ML solutions in production.
Hands-on experience building LLM-based applications: prompt engineering, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, fine-tuning and agent frameworks (e.g., Google ADK, LangChain, LlamaIndex).
Deep expertise in at least one major cloud (Azure, AWS or GCP) and its AI services.
Strong programming skills in Python, plus working knowledge of APIs, microservices, containers and Kubernetes.
Solid grounding in data architecture: pipelines, data lakes/warehouses, and data quality and governance.
Experience with model evaluation, observability and MLOps tooling (e.g., MLflow, Weights & Biases, OpenTelemetry).
Track record of explaining complex technical trade-offs to executive and non-technical audiences.
Consulting or client-facing delivery experience.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have

Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related field.
Cloud architect or AI certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer).
Experience in regulated industries such as life sciences, manufacturing, financial services or healthcare, including GxP or validated systems.
Experience integrating AI with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Salesforce or ServiceNow.

Publications, open-source contributions or conference talks in AI.

Sci-Rec is partnering with a fast-growing behavioural health AI company to hire a Senior AI Engineer. This is a confidential search.

The company

Founded by experienced healthcare technology entrepreneurs, our client is building an AI suite that is changing how behavioural health providers care for patients. Their products include an AI contact centre handling inbound patient calls around the clock, AI companions that proactively reach out to patients at moments of clinical risk, and tools that remove administrative burden from clinicians.

They’re a team of around 35 to 40, with 8 to 10 engineers. The structure is flat, engineers own their work end to end, and the company is self-funded, giving it the freedom to build for the long term.

The role

This is a hands-on engineering role. You’ll design and build production agentic AI systems, writing code day to day while also shaping architecture and technical direction. You’ll take on some of the hardest problems in the product and be expected to move quickly from idea to working feature.

What they’re looking for

A strong academic background in computer science, mathematics, physics or a related field from a leading university
Experience building complex AI systems in production, ideally at a frontier or high-growth AI company
Hands-on experience with agentic AI orchestration, with LangGraph strongly preferred
A track record of shipping quickly and owning hard problems through to delivery
Something concrete you’ve personally built that you’d be comfortable walking through
Comfort with ambiguity and the ownership mindset that comes with a small, senior team

Healthcare and voice AI experience are welcome but not required.

What’s on offer

Fully remote
Real influence over the technical direction of a growing product
The chance to apply cutting-edge AI to a field where it makes a genuine difference to patients

Interested? Click apply or reach out to me directly at Paul.Atkinson@sci-rec.com.

new_jobs.title: Distinguished AI Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Location:
This role requires associates to be in-office 3 days per week, fostering collaboration and connectivity, while providing flexibility to support productivity and work-life balance. This approach combines structured office engagement with the autonomy of virtual work, promoting a dynamic and adaptable workplace. Alternate locations may be considered if candidates reside within a commuting distance from an office.

Please note that per our policy on hybrid/virtual work, candidates not within a reasonable commuting distance from the posting location(s) will not be considered for employment, unless an accommodation is granted as required by law.

The Distinguished AI Engineer
will be responsible for leading the design, development, and deployment of large-scale, production-grade artificial intelligence (AI) systems and platforms that enable enterprise-wide innovation and modernization.

How You Will Make An Impact

Architect and deliver scalable, resilient AI solutions leveraging technologies such as agentic systems, large language models (LLMs), distributed systems, and event-driven architectures.
Define enterprise-wide technical direction, including architecture patterns, integration standards, and reusable platform capabilities.
Lead AI-driven modernization of legacy systems through automated code transformation, service decomposition, and continuous optimization.
Design and implement AI-enabled software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices to improve engineering velocity and quality.
Establish technical standards, governance frameworks, and best practices for AI systems, including monitoring, evaluation, and responsible AI.
Partner with engineering teams and stakeholders to enable adoption of AI-assisted development and drive continuous improvement in system performance and productivity.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship while influencing enterprise technology decisions through deep expertise and hands-on engineering.

Minimum Requirements

Requires a bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field and a minimum of 15 years of experience in software engineering, including experience leading, designing, implementing, and operating distributed systems and large-scale architectures, or any combination of education and experience which would provide an equivalent background. Experience designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions using Python, Java, or comparable object-oriented programming languages also required, as well as experience designing and implementing APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures, and applying cloud, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.

Preferred Skills, Capabilities And Experiences

Experience delivering production-grade AI/ML systems at scale, building agentic systems or complex LLM-based applications, modernizing large, complex legacy systems, and delivering high-quality systems is preferred.
Strong programming expertise in Python, Java, or similar technology is preferred.
Deep experience with APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures, cloud platforms, and CI/CD and DevOps practices is preferred.
Advanced experience designing and leading distributed systems and large-scale architectures is strongly preferred.
Experience establishing enterprise technology standards and influencing technical direction across multiple teams or business domains is preferred.
Experience serving as a technical authority for software engineering practices, architecture, platform strategy, and modern application architectures, including APIs, microservices, cloud technologies, and DevOps practices, is strongly preferred.

Please be advised that Elevance Health only accepts resumes for compensation from agencies that have a signed agreement with Elevance Health. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Elevance Health.

Who We Are

Elevance Health is a health company dedicated to improving lives and communities – and making healthcare simpler. We are a Fortune 25 company with a longstanding history in the healthcare industry, looking for leaders at all levels of the organization who are passionate about making an impact on our members and the communities we serve.

How We Work

At Elevance Health, we are creating a culture that is designed to advance our strategy but will also lead to personal and professional growth for our associates. Our values and behaviors are the root of our culture. They are how we achieve our strategy, power our business outcomes and drive our shared success - for our consumers, our associates, our communities and our business.

We offer a range of market-competitive total rewards that include merit increases, paid holidays, Paid Time Off, and incentive bonus programs (unless covered by a collective bargaining agreement), medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) +match, stock purchase plan, life insurance, wellness programs and financial education resources, to name a few.

Elevance Health operates in a Hybrid Workforce Strategy. Unless specified as primarily virtual by the hiring manager, associates are required to work at an Elevance Health location at least once per week, and potentially several times per week. Specific requirements and expectations for time onsite will be discussed as part of the hiring process.

The health of our associates and communities is a top priority for Elevance Health. We require all new candidates in certain patient/member-facing roles to become vaccinated against COVID-19 and Influenza. If you are not vaccinated, your offer will be rescinded unless you provide an acceptable explanation. Elevance Health will also follow all relevant federal, state and local laws.

Elevance Health is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, citizenship status, color, creed, disability, ethnicity, genetic information, gender (including gender identity and gender expression), marital status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other status or condition protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Applicants who require accommodation to participate in the job application process should submit the Accessibility Accommodation Request Form and a member of the team will be in contact.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws, including, but not limited to, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act.

Prospective employees required to be screened under Florida law should review the education and awareness resources at HB531 | Florida Agency for Health Care Administration.
